text:
Jordan: Quick check-in  sketching a compact checklist for multi-region behaviors: leases, data-plane warmup, and residency-safe fanout. Diagram in drive: https://redwood/internal/multisite/mini-checklist.png
Maya: Nice. Two asks: tiny lease proto + explicit degraded behaviors table.
Jordan: Lease proto idea: Acquire(tenant_id, preferred_site, ttl, idempotency_key) -> (holder_site, expires_at, lease_token). Writes must validate lease_token.
Liam: Active/active default with prefer-local header; require-local for residency must be enforced by proxy.
Sara: Residency rule: no raw payloads leave allowed region. For other sites return 429 + X-Redwood-RouteHint. Must call this out as MUST.
Nina: Observability: include span.attr site and tenant.residency. Metric: cross_site_fallback{tenant,from,to,reason}.
Ethan: Operator preflight: block cutover if migrations>0 in last 15m or prefetch queue not drained. ops-bot should enforce.
Maya: Cache warming: prefetch top prefixes for non-residency tenants; for residency only consent-stamp.
Liam: Conflict policy appendix: inference=request_id idempotent, metadata=merge, billing=append-only with dedupe.
Jordan: I'll draft a short RFC with proto, runbook snippets, and test cases (site kill, burst, compliance sim). Tagging owners once draft is up.
